meta.title: Pricing | SneakersLite
meta.description: Simple pay-per-result sneaker authentication pricing. No setup fee or monthly minimum; rates decrease as your monthly volume grows.

hero.description: No setup fee. No monthly minimum. Your price per result falls as your volume grows.

features: Jordan, Nike, Adidas, YEEZY, New Balance, ASICS, Converse

calculator.title: Estimate your monthly cost
calculator.description: Move the slider to see your rate at a given number of completed results per calendar month. The tier reached applies to every result that month.
calculator.monthlySaving: Estimated monthly saving vs. human authentication
calculator.humanComparison: Compared with approximately $4.00 per human-authenticated result

enterprise.title: Need an enterprise plan?
enterprise.description: Above 10,000 results a month or need custom SLAs or an on-prem review workflow? Talk to sales.

items.question: What counts as a result?
items.answer: One completed authentication decision counts as one result.

items.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
items.answer: No. There is no setup fee and no monthly minimum.

items.question: How is the tier determined?
items.answer: Your tier is determined by completed results in the calendar month. All results that month are billed at the tier reached.

items.question: What happens below the confidence threshold?
items.answer: The case is routed to human review and still counts as one result.
